select_series_element_by_index: select a single element from a Polars Series using an integer index
select_series_elements_by_slice: select a range of elements from a Polars Series using a slice or range object
select_series_elements_by_indices: select multiple elements from a Polars Series using a sequence of integer indices
select_dataframe_rows_columns: select rows and columns from a Polars DataFrame using integer or string index selectors
select_dataframe_columns_by_name: select one or more columns from a Polars DataFrame by column name or index
